newsitem.title: THAILAND: More Thai banks seen raising deposit rates - Seamico.
newsitem.headline: More Thai banks seen raising deposit rates - Seamico.

text.p: More Thai commercial banks are expected to raise their deposit rates after Bangkok Bank Plc said it would raise its rates, Seamico Securities said.
"More banks have decided to raise deposit rates following Bangkok Bank's announcement that it would be raising deposit rates by 25 to 50 basis points," Seamico said in its latest report.

Bangkok Bank executive chairman Piti Sithi-amnuai said on Friday that Thailand's biggest bank would raise deposit rates by about 25 basis points in an attempt to halt its falling market share of domestic deposits.
He declined to say whether the planned increase would be made across the board.

Seamico said the rise in deposit rates was also attributable to tighter money supply as a result of the Bank of Thailand's increased control of short-term foreign inflows and slower growth in most banks' deposits.
